# Bar and chart data

Facts about the bar being evaluated and the chart it belongs to. Several of these are fixed chart settings in PowerBridge rather than values computed from your data; each entry says so.

[Back to the keyword reference index](README.md)

### BarInterval

| Kind | Returns | Arguments | Argument types | Evidence | On MC compile list | Run status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| builtin | numeric | none (used as a value) | not established | capture (strategy-level) | yes | runs |

Size of each bar in units of the chart's resolution, for example 1 on a 1-minute chart. PowerBridge returns 1.

### barstatus

| Kind | Returns | Arguments | Argument types | Evidence | On MC compile list | Run status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| builtin | numeric | none (used as a value) | not established | capture (strategy-level) | yes | runs |

Whether the current tick opened, is inside, or closed the bar. A backtest only sees closed bars, and PowerBridge returns 0 on its sample run.

### bartype

| Kind | Returns | Arguments | Argument types | Evidence | On MC compile list | Run status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| builtin | numeric | none (used as a value) | not established | capture (strategy-level) | yes | runs |

Numeric code for the chart resolution. PowerBridge returns the code for intraday bars (1).

### bartype_ex

| Kind | Returns | Arguments | Argument types | Evidence | On MC compile list | Run status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| builtin | numeric | none (used as a value) | not established | capture (strategy-level) | yes | runs |

Extended resolution code that tells minutes apart from seconds or hours. PowerBridge returns the minute code (2).

### basedatanumber

| Kind | Returns | Arguments | Argument types | Evidence | On MC compile list | Run status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| builtin | numeric | none (used as a value) | not established | capture (strategy-level) | yes | runs |

Number of the data series the strategy is applied to. PowerBridge runs on one series, so this is 1.

### currentbar

| Kind | Returns | Arguments | Argument types | Evidence | On MC compile list | Run status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| builtin | numeric | none (used as a value) | not established | capture (strategy-level) | yes | runs |

Number of the bar being evaluated, counting from 1 at the first bar the strategy runs on.

```easylanguage
Vars: Warm(false);
Warm = CurrentBar > 20;
```

| Kind | Returns | Arguments | Argument types | Evidence | On MC compile list | Run status |

| builtin | numeric | none (used as a value) | not established | capture (strategy-level) | yes | runs |

### datetime

| Kind | Returns | Arguments | Argument types | Evidence | On MC compile list | Run status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| builtin | numeric | none (used as a value) | not established | capture (strategy-level) | yes | runs |

Date and time of the current bar as one number. In PowerBridge the date part is the calendar date written as YYYYMMDD, the form the `...FromDateTime` words read.

```easylanguage
Vars: Y(0);
Y = YearFromDateTime(DateTime);
```

| Kind | Returns | Arguments | Argument types | Evidence | On MC compile list | Run status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| builtin | numeric | none (used as a value) | not established | capture (strategy-level) | yes | runs |

Real-time execution offset. On historical bars it is 0, which is what PowerBridge returns.

### maxbarsback

| Kind | Returns | Arguments | Argument types | Evidence | On MC compile list | Run status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| builtin | numeric | none (used as a value) | not established | capture (strategy-level) | yes | runs |

|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| builtin | numeric | none (used as a value) | not established | capture (strategy-level) | yes | runs |

Chart setting for how many empty bars are shown after the last bar. PowerBridge returns a fixed 16.

### tickid

| Kind | Returns | Arguments | Argument types | Evidence | On MC compile list | Run status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| builtin | numeric | none (used as a value) | not established | capture (strategy-level) | yes | runs |

Identifier of the latest tick, used in real-time trading. It is 0 on historical bars, and PowerBridge always returns 0.
